descriptions.shortDescription: Framework voor gefedereerde catalogi in Nextcloud
descriptions.longDescription:
OpenCatalogi biedt een framework waarmee gefedereerde catalogi samenwerken
in een open data ecosysteem. De app synchroniseert bronnen met meerdere
catalogi en ondersteunt automatische publicatie van open data conform de
DIWOO-standaard.
Conduction onderhoudt dit component in opdracht van Gemeente Rotterdam.
De app is te installeren via de Nextcloud App Store:
https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/opencatalogi
features: Pagina's, menu's en thema's voor de publieke frontend

descriptions.shortDescription: Framework for federated catalogs in Nextcloud
descriptions.longDescription:
OpenCatalogi provides a framework for federated catalogs to work together
in an open data ecosystem. The app synchronises sources with multiple
catalogs and supports automatic publication of open data following the
DIWOO metadata standard.
Conduction maintains this component on behalf of the Municipality of Rotterdam.
The app can be installed from the Nextcloud App Store:
https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/opencatalogi
features: Public search API for external frontends
Pages, menus and themes for the public frontend

results.title: Project health (CHAOSS)
results.description: How active and widely carried the project is: the bus factor, the spread over organisations, how change requests and issues are handled, and how often it releases. Informative: shown, not rated.
results.message: 6 of 6 CHAOSS metrics measured. They are shown for information and do not count in any rating.

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 11 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 300 commits of the last 12 months (180 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is conduction.nl (4 authors), with 89% of the 180 commits whose organisation is known; 0% of the commits come from 0 of 5 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
metrics.explanation: 1,499 change requests were closed (merged or not) and 1,553 opened in the last 90 days, bots included. Below 1 the open backlog grows; above 1 it shrinks.

metrics.name: Time to First Response
metrics.explanation: None of the 15 latest change requests opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13 got a comment or review from anyone but its author.

metrics.name: Issue Response Time
metrics.explanation: The median time to the first comment by someone other than the author, over the 15 latest issues opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13. 5 got a response; 10 had none yet. Bots are left out.

metrics.name: Release Frequency
metrics.explanation: 24 final releases were published in the last 12 months, about one every 15 days, counted from the GitHub releases. The latest final release is from 2026-09-06. Besides these, 738 pre-releases were published; they are not counted. Drafts and pre-releases are left out.
